context.body: The builder and beneficiary reverse: David will not build God’s house, but God will build David’s.

observations.body: The LORD recalls moving in a tent, rejects David’s proposed temple role, and promises David a house, son, kingdom, and enduring throne.
observations.label: God refuses David’s house and promises one: action

observations.body: David desires to build; Nathan first agrees, then carries the corrected word.

payload.posture: Read 2 Samuel 7:1–17 as land, judges, and kings evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The promise includes enduring language and discipline without explaining every later form of fulfillment.
